_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Joint Precision Approach and Landing System (JPALS) Certification Plan
summary: The JPALS Certification Plan describes the Contractor's plan for delivery of Guidance, Navigation, and Control models, algorithms, and certification data artifacts in support of Government JPALS Certification activities.
use_relationship:
The Joint Precision Approach and Landing System (JPALS) Certification Plan describes the Contractor's plan for delivery of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C) models, algorithms, and certification data artifacts in support of Government JPALS Certification activities.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the JPALS Certification Plan.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor's format is acceptable. If the models have been developed in a commonly available design and analysis tool (such as Matlab and Simulink) then delivery of the models in such format is acceptable.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The JPALS Certification Plan shall contain the following information:

children.title: Airborne GN&C Models.
GN&C system models and algorithms, including the inner loop and outer loop control laws.
Gains, limits, and filter values needed for the GN&C models.
Flight Test Activities
Description of how flight test activities will support the Government's JPALS Certification efforts.
Real-Time Certification Data
Inner loop control law inputs
Vertical displacement of the touchdown point, including the un-stabilized touchdown point and the touchdown point with Deck Motion Compensation (DMC) commands.
Lateral displacement of the touchdown point, including the un-stabilized touchdown point and the touchdown point with DMC commands (if applicable).

Description of how the real-time certification data is provided and the path from the sensor/system generating the data to the production aircraft data bus, in-flight data recorder, and telemetry system.
Certification Data for Post Processing
Inner loop control law inputs and outputs.
Outer loop control law inputs and outputs.
Guidance algorithm inputs and outputs.
Navigation algorithm inputs and outputs.
Sensor outputs from systems that feed guidance and control (e.g. Embedded Global Positioning System (GPS) Inertial Navigation System (INS) (EGI), Air Data System).
Independent navigation reference source outputs.
Engine Throttle and revolutions per minute (RPM).
Control surface positions.
Stabilized and un-stabilized relative position vector.
Vertical displacement of the touchdown point, including the un-stabilized touchdown point and the touchdown point with DMC commands.
Lateral displacement of the touchdown point, including the un-stabilized touchdown point and the touchdown point with DMC commands (if applicable).
Description of how the data for post processing is provided and the path from the sensor/system generating the data to the inflight data recorder.
